Named NIH funding, award formats, and scientific purposes align.

The caveats disclose this uncertainty but leave the current-release field inventory partly unresolved.

semantic_insights: The root consistently identifies the adult 3.1.0 release and treats the pediatric dataset as a separate related resource.
The project DOI and release DOI have distinct, explicitly explained roles; the citation, page, version, and participant count are coherent.
Registered feature access and controlled raw-audio access are distinguished, with consent, deidentification procedures, and residual voice-recognition risk documented.
Processing transparency is particularly strong: named software and parameterized transformations explain how raw recordings and clinical source data became released features and phenotype files.
Prose descriptions meaningfully identify recruitment bias, site/device confounding, and representation skews without requiring explicit taxonomy codes.
The supplied empty applicability context leaves every conditional predicate unknown. All 50 items remain scored, with no exclusions.
